findings.observation: 'Pinned, verified images' while compose pulled mutable tags without a digest check
findings.observationSource: Independent review of the v1.1.4 snapshot (public 837e0b0), 2026-10-14
findings.disposition: Public 813b76b: pgvector, Temporal and codex-lb are pinned by multi-arch index digest (headroom already was); the README and security model now say that SpaceApp images are pulled by exact version tag, which the release workflow publishes once (it fails closed when a tag exists) with SBOM and provenance attestations it verifies. Open: verifying the first-party digest or attestation at install time. Internal review 1.1.5 Codex #9: still open for SpaceApp's own images; planned for 1.1.7. External review 2026-10-16 #8. 2026-10-17: public overlay 219b4c0 (ships in run-spaceapp 1.1.7, with the codex-sessions-init service pinned too): after the images are published and verified, the release writes their digests into the tested npm package (templates/images.lock.json, the only allowed difference) and the launcher pulls name:version@sha256; the devtest probe accepts pinned images. Proven only by the next real publish. 1.1.8 (public overlay branch, task:6sCDD1rdjPyC): before an installation first uses a locked version, the launcher checks its images (packages/run-spaceapp/src/image-attestations.mjs): every platform image in each pinned index needs an SBOM and an SLSA provenance statement about that exact image from oll4com/spaceapp's release.yml on main, all read by digest from the pinned index; it records the run and commit in image-attestations.json and stops before pulling otherwise. The release's verify-published-containers.mjs runs the same check, with this run's commit for a full release. The reads use HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY, or else the Docker client's proxies.default in ~/.docker/config.json; an unreachable registry stops with those settings named, and a failed check stops whatever the proxy settings. Known limitation: SPACEAPP_IMAGE_VERIFY=off skips the check on air-gapped or locked-down hosts; every launcher run then warns, and the version stays recorded as unverified until a run without it verifies it. Checked read-only against the published 1.1.7 images (run 39996418646, f1c4e83), directly and through a CONNECT proxy. Evidence still missing: an install of a published 1.1.8 package.
